courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 高速道岔組裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「簡支跨中彎矩」與「裂縫開口變化」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高速道岔組裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Simply supported midspan moment" and "Crack-opening change" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of High-speed turnout assembly must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦軌枕彎曲預力疲勞與環境耐久；高速道岔組裝則以道岔線形組裝公差與輪軌導引為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sleeper bending prestress fatigue and environmental durability; High-speed turnout assembly centres on turnout alignment assembly tolerances and wheel guidance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「簡支跨中彎矩」與「道岔分岔角估算」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高速道岔組裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「緊固件夾持分配」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Simply supported midspan moment” and “Turnout divergence angle”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to High-speed turnout assembly, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fastener clamp-force allocation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「簡支跨中彎矩」與「落體到達時間」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Simply supported midspan moment” and “Falling-object arrival time”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Trackside rockfall and obstruction detection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 軌枕耐久與承載試驗
history.text: 本課把軌枕耐久與承載試驗放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。軌枕把扣件荷載分散至道碴或支承面，軌座與中部彎矩取決於接觸分布；承載試驗和耐久試驗需要分別定義邊界與損傷指標。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Sleeper durability and load testing in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Sleepers distribute fastening loads to ballast or support surfaces; rail-seat and centre moments depend on contact distribution, so load tests and durability tests need separate boundaries and damage indicators. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.textEn: FRA issued its updated Track and Structures Compliance Manual.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「簡支跨中彎矩」到「動態彈模比較」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Simply supported midspan moment" through "Dynamic modulus ratio" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
